cli_discovery.notes: Not found on system PATH or within venv/Scripts

manual_activation_procedure: 1. Sign up or log in to Lightning AI at https://lightning.ai
2. Navigate to User Profile -> Settings -> API Keys -> click 'Create API Key'
3. Install Lightning CLI in project virtual environment: 'pip install lightning'
4. Authenticate via CLI: 'lightning login' (or set environment variable LIGHTNING_API_KEY)
security_note: No credentials were requested in chat or stored by the assistant. Follow manual setup only.
